faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Can I finance a car with no credit history?
faq.a1: Yes. We work with multiple banks and offer in-house financing options tailored for first-time buyers, with flexible down payments starting from 10%.
faq.q2: Do you accept trade-ins on any brand?
faq.a2: We accept trade-ins on all makes and models. Bring your car in for a free valuation — most quotes are ready within 30 minutes.
faq.a3: Every vehicle undergoes a 120-point inspection covering the engine, transmission, electronics and body before it's listed for sale.
faq.q4: Can I book a test drive online?
faq.a4: Yes, use the contact form below or call our showroom directly. Test drives can usually be arranged the same day.
faq.q5: What warranty comes with a used car?
faq.a5: All certified pre-owned vehicles include a 1-year or 20,000km warranty, whichever comes first, covering major mechanical components.
